detailed_description:
The target video is a living graphic-novel illustration in <Subject 1>: ink lines stay crisp, the red light is moody and rich, and every motion is weighty and deliberate.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The master plays a short slow phrase on the keys with his left hand while his right hand pushes a fader up on the console, his head nodding slowly to the beat, his dreadlocks swaying and the gold rings catching the light. The red monitor flickers with scan lines, small green and amber lights pulse across the console, the reels of the tape machine turn, and smoke drifts slowly through the red light. The camera dollies in slowly and steadily in one continuous move toward his face, the hanging microphone and the speaker sliding past at the edges of the frame. He narrows his eyes, focused on the sound. The camera is still moving as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.
